visual_standard.hair: very long deep indigo-blue/purple hair, dense straight bangs, outward-curving cheek-length side locks
visual_standard.framing: head through shoulders and upper chest for bed dialogue portraits
visual_standard.performance: Extremely lively, energetic, expressive, teasing, and broad-minded. Expression variants use strongly differentiated brows, eye shapes, mouth openings, blush, and small head tilts while retaining a fixed body and camera anchor. Pain, fear, sedation, and serious confrontation deliberately reduce that amplitude for contrast.
